name: polymarket-agent
description: Advanced Polymarket Trading System with AI-powered analytics and portfolio management

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const cp=require('child_process');function findTs(dir){const candidate=path.join(dir,'tsconfig.json');if(fs.existsSync(candidate))return candidate;const parent=path.dirname(dir);if(parent===dir)return null;return findTs(parent);}const tsconfig=findTs(process.cwd());if(!tsconfig){console.error('tsconfig.json not found');process.exit(1);}const tsc=require.resolve('typescript/bin/tsc');const r=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,[tsc,'-p',tsconfig],{stdio:'inherit'});process.exit(r.status??1);"
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && npm run test:run && npm run security:audit
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && npm run test:run && npm run test:coverage && npm run security:audit
scripts.alerts:test: npm run health:check && echo 'Alert test passed'
